content: Jesucrist nted xkwent be lo Dios
Mod xiin na nzak na gu, kwaanzee kakee na kwaane lo gu zee nalet gu kwaan nawent. Per chelee tub be zeb jwalt, nkano be tub xaa nted xkwent be lo Xuz be Dios, lee xaa ne nak Jesucrist, Xaa Nali.
Lee xaa mdix rese jwalt cheen be kwaan yalnaban cheen xaa, zee chee Dios jwalt cheen be; nu nanakta nebse cheen re be, noka mdix xaa jwalt cheen rese myet, xaa dubse yizhyo.
Snee mod ne be, chelee be wlipa nlabeyy be xaa, chelee be nzhon be xtizh xaa.
Per chelee tub xaa yé: “Nlabeyy na Dios”, nu nanzhont xaa xtizh xaa, nkade xaa; nu nawlit re kwaan mbezh xaa.
Per chelee tub xaa gon xtizh Dios, zee lee yalnkela cheen Dios nzhero leen lextoo xaa. Sbaa ne be chelee be nzo be kwaan lee xaa.
Loka xaa nii: “Tubka nzo na kwaan Dios”, nzhaal le xaa mod mle Jesucrist.
Nzhaal kela be tub be stub be
Re wech nu bzan, wdizh kwaan mxaal Jesucrist nak kwaan kakee na lo gu nu nanakta kwaan kub, leeya nak wdizh kwaan ngunii xaa lo gu axta yilo, nu leeya nak wdizh kwaan mbinla gu.
Per nixa seeya, kwaan kakee na lo gu nak tub wdizh kub; kwaan mle Jesucrist nu kwaan nle re be nal, nu sbaa lee yalnakaw nzhadedla, nu lee xni kwaan wli nzelo la.
Loka xaa nii: “Na nzo lo xni”, nu nayii xaa ne xaa tub xaa sawlazh Dios, seesa nzoka xaa zee lo yalnakaw.
Loka xaa nkela re xaa sawlazh Dios, lo xni nzo xaa zee; kwaanzee naralt nii xaa lo kwaan nawent nu nalet xaa ralnii stub xaa lo kwaan nawent.
Loka xaa nayii ne tub sawlazh Dios, lo yalnakaw nzo xaa nu nze xaa lo yalnakaw, nu nanet xaa pa ya xaa, nel lee yalnakaw msaaw zaalo xaa.

content.text: Kakee na kwaane lo rese gu madwin,
nel rese kwaan nawent kwaan mle gu mbyiibla kwent cheen kwaan mle Jesucrist.
Kakee na kwaane lo rese gu xaa gol,
nel nlabeyy gu xaa nzho axta yilotlaka.
Kakee na kwaane lo rese gu xaa mad,
nel mle gu gan lo Maxuu.
Nkee na kwaane lo rese gu madwin,
Nkee na kwaane lo rese gu xaa gol,
nel nlabeyy gu xaa nzo axta yilotlaka.
Nkee na kwaane lo rese gu xaa mad,
nel ngezh gu, nu nel nla xtizh Dios lextoo gu, nu mle gu gan lo Maxuu.

content: Nazoblazht be yizhyo ne, nu nixa re xcheen yizhyo ne. Chelee tub be nzoblazh xcheen yizhyo ne, nankelat xaa zee Xuz be Dios.

Rese kwaan nawent kwaan nzho yizhyo ne, nanakta cheen Dios; leeya nak kwenta nzoblazh myet re kwaan nyula kwerp cheen xaa, nu nzoblazh myet kano re kwaan chul nlu lo xaa, nu nto xaa yalxwa; rese kwaane nak xcheen yizhyo.
Yizhyo ne lux, nu rese kwaan nawent kwaan nzho lo yizhyo ne; per loka xaa nle kwaana nzhekla Dios, xaa zee zaa Dios yalnaban kwaan tira lo.
Yalnkade nu kwaan wli

Nii na lo rese gu, xaa nak mod xiin na, merla mzhin mbizh gwluzhtlaka. Mbinla gu lee tub xaa yiid, xaa nak kontrad cheen Jesucrist; zyen doo xaa snee nzhayiidla, nu kwaanzee ne be mer mzhinla mbizh gwluzhtlaka.
Leeka lo re be mroo xaa zee, per nanakt xaa xaa be. Chelee xaa be nak xaa, nangroot xaa lo be; per snee ngoka zee luu lee rese xaa zee nanakt xaa be.
Gu mkayaa Mbi Naban, zee rese gu ne kwaan wli.
Kakee na kwaane lo gu, nu nanakta nel nanlabeyyt gu kwaan wli, sinka nlabeyy guya, kwaanzee kakee naya lo gu. Lee yalnkade naroot lo xaa wli.
¿Cho nak xaa nkade? Xaa nkade nak xaa yé lee Jesús nanakt Crist, Xaa Mxaal Dios Nabeyy. Nu xaa zee nak kontrad cheen Jesucrist, nu nii xaa Dios nanakt xuz Jesús nu Jesús nanakt Xgann Dios.
Rese xaa yé lee Jesús nawlit nak Xgann Dios, lee xaa zee nanakt xinn Dios; per loka xaa yé Jesús nak Xgann Dios, lee xaa zee nak xinn Dios.
Blochaw gu re kwaan mbin gu yilo lextoo gu, zee tubka zo gu kwaan Xuz be nu Xgann xaa, chelee kwaan mbin gu yilo nzho lextoo gu.
Nu nguniila Dios zaa xaa yalnaban kwaan tira lo be.
Kakee na kwaane lo gu, nel nzho xaa nzhekla kade gu.

Per nzho Mbi Naban lextoo be nel mzaa Jesucrist Mbi Naban lo be, nu nankint be stub xaa seed be, nel leeka Mbi Naban luu rese kwaan lo be, nu kwaan luu xaa nak kwaan wli, nanakta yalnkade. Tubka zo be kwaan Jesucrist, kwentaxa mlu Mbi Naban lo be.
Kwaanzee rese gu, xaa mod xiin na, nkin tubka zo be kwaan Jesucrist. Zee gorna yaad xaa stub welt, zee nazhebt be ne be xaa, nu natont be ne be xaa.
Chelee gu ne gu lee Jesús nali nak, seeka ne gu rese xaa nali nle nak xinn xaa.
